issues.where: the main tree trunk and the forks of its large branches
issues.what: Near-continuous orange-and-black grooves repeat over the entire trunk and wrap smoothly around every fork, making the tree look like polished, carved wood rather than bark.
issues.fix: Break up the long grooves with irregular bark plates, short fissures and knot scars; mute the bright ridges and vary roughness between ridges and crevices.

issues.where: crops 2 and 4, the snow resting on the tree crown
issues.what: The snow overhangs end in thick, rounded fingers and hard wedges, with little transition into the fine foliage beneath, so they look like separate pieces placed on the crown.
issues.fix: Follow the small branch and foliage contours with thinner, porous snow edges, finer granular deposits and small pockets of contact shadow.

issues.where: crops 7 and 8, along the distant snowbank behind the lamp and to the right of the trunk
issues.what: Multiple parallel light and dark bands trace the same ridge line and read as a stepped render edge rather than a continuous out-of-focus snowbank.
issues.fix: Remove the repeated contours with a continuous depth-of-field transition and dithering before grading and export.

issues.where: crops 9 and 10, the shrubs under the windows and next to the door
issues.what: Large angular white and green planes show through the blur; the snow looks like flat cutout leaves instead of accumulation on a shrub.
issues.fix: Use smaller overlapping leaves and twigs, then place uneven snow clumps on their upward-facing surfaces with visible layering and occlusion.

issues.where: crop 1, immediately above the chimney cap
issues.what: The white plume begins as a smooth, nearly opaque column with a bulb at its base, making it read like solid geometry rather than smoke.
issues.fix: Use a translucent, turbulent plume that widens and dissipates irregularly, with soft edges and gaps in density.

issues.where: crop 11, over the lit roots and lower trunk
issues.what: Several in-focus snow flecks resolve as flat, bright polygon shards, including near-matching silhouettes close together.
issues.fix: Replace sharp polygon sprites with varied, softly lit flake silhouettes and match their edge softness to the local focus and motion.
